source.article: An Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything
source.author: A. Garrett Lisi
primary_source_statements: §2.2.3 Eq(2.10), PDF page 12: H1=(1/2)*omega+(1/4)*e*phi+w_ew in Cl(7,1), e is Clifford vector ONE_FORM and phi is four-real-component Clifford vector SCALAR.
§3.1 printed page 23: W+B1 are distinct electroweak one-form connections; e*phi is the ordered mixed graviweak 1-form.
§3.1 Eq(3.2), printed page 24: F=d(A)+A*A in differential-form graded algebra with F1=F_G+F_gw+F_ew.
§3.1 Eq(3.3), printed page 24: F_G=(1/2)*(R-(1/8)*e*e*phi^2); when omega=0 and d(omega)=0, R=0 and the Higgs quadratic term has coefficient -1/16.
§3.1 Eq(3.4), printed page 24: F_gw=(d(e)+(1/2)*[omega,e])*phi-e*(d(phi)+[W+B1,phi]); omega=W=B1=0 gives d(e)*phi-e*d(phi).

definition.primitive_source_role: eight Cl(7,1) 16x16 source gamma generators are real/complex Gaussian coefficient matrices built from source-printed Pauli tensor product. First four are gravity, last four primed electroweak; no imported cross-domain theorem.
definition.mixed_source_basis: M_(mu,alpha)=Gamma_mu*GammaPrime_alpha for mu=0..3 and alpha=0..3, ordered gravity-first product, 16 independent even-grade basis matrices
definition.mixed_1form_E: E=sum_mu sum_alpha e^mu*phi^alpha*M_(mu,alpha) with e^mu 1-form and phi^alpha real scalar, do not commute exterior factors across sign
definition.curvature: F(H1)=d(H1)+H1 wedge H1, with matrix products and exterior wedge; do not interpret matrix multiplications as same thing as graded differential-form products
definition.restricted_variables: omega=W=B1=0 as 1-forms in neighbourhood, d(omega)=d(W)=d(B1)=0, e is an INVERTIBLE coframe (nondegenerate at origin), phi real in Cl(4), no spinor/Grassmann excitation
definition.source_jets: All diagnostics are off-shell local 1-jets satisfying the stated field types; no claim that they solve the source dynamics or Einstein constraints.

independent_algebra_predictions.Clifford_anticonmutation: Gamma_I Gamma_J+Gamma_J Gamma_I=2*eta_IJ*I16 for all 64 ordered source generator pairs
independent_algebra_predictions.mixed_mixed_commutator: For M_(mu,a)=Gamma_mu GammaPrime_a, [M_(mu,a),M_(nu,b)] equals -2*Gamma_mu Gamma_nu when mu!=nu and a==b; equals -2*eta_mu*GammaPrime_a GammaPrime_b when mu==nu and a!=b; equals 0 for mu!=nu,a!=b or identical indices.
independent_algebra_predictions.commutator_population: 16 mixed generators -> 120 unordered pairs. 24 same electroweak index/different gravity pairs, 24 same gravity index/different EW pairs, 72 zero pairs. No commutator maps to mixed span.
independent_algebra_predictions.quadratic_pure_gravity: For arbitrary real phi=(phi1,...,phi4) and distinct mu,nu, let X_mu=sum_alpha phi_alpha*M_(mu,alpha). Then [X_mu,X_nu]=-(sum_alpha phi_alpha^2)*[Gamma_mu,Gamma_nu].
independent_algebra_predictions.quadratic_source_coefficient: (1/4)^2*E wedge E=-(1/16)*(e wedge e)*phi^2, where e wedge e uses original unscaled gravity Clifford coefficients. This matches source Eq(3.3)'s -1/2*1/8=-1/16 under omega=0.
independent_algebra_predictions.graded_derivative: Since e is degree1 and phi degree0, d(e*phi)=d(e)*phi-e wedge d(phi). Thus the raw mixed coefficient in the source Gamma_mu*GammaPrime_alpha basis is (1/4)*(d(e)*phi-e*d(phi)) when omega=W=B1 vanish.

admissible_source_field_controls.scope: Flat invertible source frame, phi!=0, torsion-free connection chosen zero; smooth off-shell Higgs gradient.
admissible_source_field_controls.coordinate_model: x=(x1,x2,x3,x4). e^mu=dx^mu all mu; phi^1=1+x1; phi^(2..4)=0; omega=W=B1=0; at x=0 det(e)=1, dphi^1=dx1, de^mu=0.
admissible_source_field_controls.output_2form: mixed component dx1 wedge dx2 along M_(mu2,alpha1) is +1/4 from d(H1); printed unscaled F_gw is +1 under same unscaled M coordinate convention. Pure H1^2 has NO mixed component.

admissible_source_field_controls.scope: Source coframe still invertible at origin, phi!=0, torsion may be nonzero off-shell with zero spin connection.
admissible_source_field_controls.coordinate_model: e^1=(1+x2)*dx1, e^2=dx2, e^3=dx3, e^4=dx4; phi^1=1 other phi=0; omega=W=B1=0; at x=0 det(e)=1, de^1=dx2 wedge dx1.
admissible_source_field_controls.output_2form: mixed dx1 wedge dx2 along M_(mu1,alpha1) is -1/4 from d(H1); printed F_gw is -1 under same unscaled M coordinates.

competing_comparison_contracts.statement: Assume printed named F_gw and raw d(H1) mixed term are presented in exact same unscaled source M=Gamma_mu GammaPrime_alpha basis and are compared as algebra-valued two-forms.
competing_comparison_contracts.predicted_result: They differ by factor 4 on admissible nondegenerate field jets.

competing_comparison_contracts.statement: Define N_(mu,alpha)=M_(mu,alpha)/4 as a project-level output generator convention; then the raw mixed coefficient in N coordinates equals the unscaled source Eq(3.4) coefficient.
competing_comparison_contracts.predicted_result: No factor-four numerical discrepancy remains in those normalized coordinates.

repair_disposition: No correction to original L01 formulas justified: missing author-specified common-output projection or generator normalization is load-bearing. The older e=0-at-point witness is a degenerate coframe and cannot alone establish physical frame admissibility; the two new nondegenerate off-shell jets test the same conditional difference without that issue.
discovery_disposition: The apparent factor 4 is evidence of a required basis/projection role distinction. Whether source intended output basis M or N (or another normalization) remains unresolved; do not label it an erratum or assume N is source-approved.
relevant_external_knowledge: None. No W mathematics, other author's independent scheme, or conventional Clifford repair used as an unexamined source-authority premise.

Then conserve only conditional G0 findings in L-SSC-039 if the scope-limited replay passes. Full graded connection source output normalization still open, G1–G7 still forbidden.
